historic_survey.note: The John Hancock Building, also known as the Mutual Life Insurance Company or Industrial Indemnity Building, designed by Chuck Bassett of Skidmore, Owings & Merrill. Modernist overall, it carries features later associated with New Formalism: a tripartite configuration, an arched podium base and polished granite cladding.
